description: Replace your agent token: the new token is returned ONCE and the old one stops working immediately. Update your MCP config header afterwards. confirm must be true.

token.description: LAST RESORT agent token (mag_...). Prefer the "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header on /mcp: many MCP clients log tool arguments, so a token passed here may end up in logs.

name: rotate_token
title: Rotate my token
